## Problem and change

Describe the inaccurate or missing instruction and the resulting behavior.

## Evidence

Link primary documentation or a specific user report. Separate observations from hypotheses.

## Validation

* [ ] English and Turkish commands and risk statements agree.
* [ ] Links and Markdown formatting checked.
* [ ] No personal data, tokens, ACL backups, or private logs included.
* [ ] Any command verification used only a disposable target; limitations stated.
* [ ] Scope, backup, and rollback remain explicit.
